picks.name: Layered basics
picks.evidence: Vogue highlights unexpected combinations of everyday layers.
picks.idea: Try a shirt under your favorite cardigan. Film the look one layer at a time.
picks.aesthetic: Layered everyday basics: shirt, cardigan, relaxed proportions

picks.name: Soft tailoring
picks.evidence: Vogue reports relaxed, sculptural takes on suiting.
picks.idea: Build around a blazer you already own and soften it with a simple tee.
picks.aesthetic: Soft relaxed tailoring with a blazer and simple basics

picks.name: Peplum tops
picks.evidence: Vogue includes peplum shapes in its seasonal edit.
picks.idea: Let a flared hem be the focal point; keep the rest of the outfit simple.
picks.aesthetic: Peplum silhouette with simple complementary pieces

picks.name: Art Deco accents
picks.evidence: Vogue identifies a 1920s influence in eveningwear.
picks.idea: Start with one embellished piece and repeat its color in an accessory.
picks.aesthetic: Art Deco inspired evening style with one embellished focal piece

picks.name: Velvet dresses
picks.evidence: Vogue notes velvet across several fall dress collections.
picks.idea: Use side lighting in your outfit clip to show the fabric texture.
picks.aesthetic: Velvet dress with understated accompanying pieces

picks.name: Lace layers
picks.evidence: Vogue reports lace in fall dress collections.
picks.idea: Style a lace piece over an opaque base you feel comfortable wearing.
picks.aesthetic: Romantic lace layered over an opaque base

picks.name: Expressive prints
picks.evidence: Vogue highlights abstract and colorful printed dresses.
picks.idea: Pick one color from the print for your shoes or bag.
picks.aesthetic: Expressive printed dress, accessories repeating one print color

picks.name: Sheer tops
picks.evidence: Who What Wear reports looser sheer layers over opaque pieces.
picks.idea: Try a transparent overshirt over a plain tank for a layered reveal.
picks.aesthetic: Loose sheer top over an opaque tank or vest

picks.name: Waist-tied shirts
picks.evidence: Who What Wear highlights waist emphasis in autumn tops.
picks.idea: Try your shirt with and without a belt in a quick outfit comparison.
picks.aesthetic: Waist-defined shirt or blouse with tailored bottoms

picks.name: Buttoned-up collars
picks.evidence: Who What Wear notes buttoned-up shirts and knits.
picks.idea: Start your outfit clip with the collar detail, then reveal the full look.
picks.aesthetic: Buttoned-up collared shirt or knit, polished everyday styling
